title: Management desktop durable CRUD ownership and canonical postmortem view

implemented: Bound the generic entity create drawer to an explicit durable-owner registry; only Persona creation remains enabled and all unsupported generic create, update, and delete calls fail closed before local overlay or mock persistence can run.
Made unsupported generic CRUD visibly disabled in the Management desktop without requiring a Tooltip provider, while preserving configured redirect-only navigation actions.

Replaced the five low-level Persona onboarding mutations with one typed Persona provisioning-controller reconcile command at POST /bff/personas/{persona_id}/provisioning/reconcile and canonical Persona readback.

Added a canonical postmortem list/detail client that requires postmortem_id, rejects missing or mismatched identity, and keeps list selection and browser reload keyed by the exact encoded postmortem_id.

Replaced incident-timeline postmortem synthesis and generated pm_{incident_id} identities with canonical list/detail rendering, explicit strict-live errors, surface degradation, and staleness disclosure.
not_changed: No BFF endpoint, backend controller, schema, dev credential, or deployment workflow was changed.
No typed write framework, Management shell, bundle cleanup, or unrelated Management surface was redesigned.
No real-write profile was enabled and no product mutation was sent during validation.
fail_closed: Entities without a typed durable create owner render a disabled create action and cannot enter EntityCreateDrawer.
Direct unsupported create, update, and delete helper calls reject with DURABLE_WRITE_OWNER_REQUIRED instead of falling back to writeOverlay, mock persistence, or seed data.
Postmortem payloads without canonical postmortem_id, or detail payloads whose postmortem_id differs from the requested identity, are rejected rather than rendered under a fabricated identity.
